It can be seen that the sequence has discrete sample values with amplitude 1 at k=3,4,5,6, and the other displayed positions are 0. Reasoning: This is a rectangular sequence with unit amplitude, with support interval k=3,4,5,6. It starts being 1 from k=3, which can be represented as turned on by the unit step ε(k-3); it needs to become 0 again from k=7, therefore subtract ε(k-7). Therefore the closed-form expression is f(k)=ε(k-3)-ε(k-7).
